name: cortana-ui
description: Cortana's Electron app - two windows in one process. The control panel (PROMPTS.md A12): conversation history, live tool-call feed, per-stage latency, memory inspector, active-model indicator - function over polish, this is where the rest of the system gets debugged from. The character overlay (PROMPTS.md A15): a transparent, click-through, always-on-top Live2D window that walks between monitors and tracks your cursor with her eyes.
